rdfs:label: hasTopic
rdfs:comment: The Topic (folder/category node, a bookmark:Topic) under which a Bookmark is filed; topics nest via bookmark:subTopicOf.
notes: Upstream (W3C bookmark vocabulary) the value is a `bookmark:Topic` resource — a hierarchical folder that nests via `bookmark:subTopicOf` — and every bookmark should have at least one. Plain-string tags are a looser convention some apps use; prefer Topic IRIs. Distinct from `urn:solid:topic` (foaf:topic) and `urn:solid:categories` (iCalendar keywords). For ActivityPub-style hashtag references prefer `as:tag`; for schema.org-style keywords prefer `schema:keywords`.

history.note: Comment/notes: value is a bookmark:Topic folder node, not a free string; example uses Topic IRIs; added topic/categories to notToBeConfusedWith.
